# An overpayment whose `prepayment:` says the wrong figure.
#
# `prepayment:` states the credit a payment beyond the document leaves behind.
# On the `txn_guid:` routes this tool carves the residue itself and compares
# the figure exactly; on this one GnuCash carves it, and nothing read the
# declaration at all — so `prepayment: 50` on a payment that leaves 100.00
# imported with `Errors: 0` and the next export wrote `prepayment: 100.00`
# back. The identical misstatement written the other way is refused.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming both figures, and no payment.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_settling_into_a_third_currency.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:HKD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD-OVER-WRONG"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-OVER-WRONG"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 200
		account: "Assets:Bank:HKD"
		settled_amount: 1560.00
		prepayment: 50
		memo: "Payment for INV-USD-OVER-WRONG"
		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
